cases.description: Chinese web-page technical trend report from a Tencent News article plus public supplemental sources.
cases.prompt: 请抓取并完整阅读 https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20251207A0337Y00，同时搜索其他公开来源，生成中文深度技术趋势报告。报告必须说明主要技术趋势、产业影响、关键不确定性，并把主要技术判断追溯到实际来源。

cases.description: English technical survey for reliability and evaluation methods in retrieval-augmented generation systems.
cases.source: Reliability and evaluation methods for retrieval-augmented generation systems
cases.prompt: Search public sources and generate an English technical survey on reliability and evaluation methods for retrieval-augmented generation systems. Cover evaluation dimensions, benchmark design, failure modes, observability, trade-offs, and open research problems, with major technical judgments traceable to actual sources.
